texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.How have you used AI in the last 2 weeks: Daily - AI is my production environment, not a side tool. In the last two weeks: ran my 6-machine Claude agent fleet (public at github.com/tonydzi) that syncs a 17k-contact CRM through MCP connectors (Telegram, Gmail), answers questions over a 10-year knowledge base with RAG (local embeddings + reranking, deterministic zero-token gates before any LLM call), turns call transcripts into follow-ups, and cross-reviews its own code with a multi-vendor panel (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok). Failure modes and evals are published openly (claw-consensus, verbatim-citation-gate). The habit that matters for a Solutions Architect: deterministic extraction first, LLM only for judgment - exactly the discipline messy customer data pipelines need.
